name: @portfolio/jobs
description: Azure Functions (Timer triggers) for Woofi Developments: uptime checks for the status page, and the GitHub/GitLab contribution sync the heatmap reads. NOTE: deliberately NOT part of the application/ npm workspace — the Functions deploy zips this folder including its node_modules, and a hoisted install would leave that zip without dependencies. It therefore keeps its own lockfile and is installed on its own.
author: Kofler Phillip
